**Finding: MISSING (critical) — no indemnification anywhere in the Agreement.**

- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infring" turned up nothing indemnity-related; the only "liability" hits are the no-joint-venture clause (§10.2). There is also no limitation of liability.
- HDI is clearly the vendor (designs, develops, hosts, operates, maintains and promotes the Site under §§1.1–1.8; performs "Services" per §8.1), and the Company retains editorial control and supplies Content and Marks — yet HDI has no duty to defend the Company against third-party claims, including IP infringement claims arising from the Site, HDI's software/systems, or HDI's cross-promotions (§7.2 is a bare covenant with no indemnity).

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new §9(c) inserted after p0058 — i.e., at the end of Warranties and immediately before General Provisions — giving the Company and its affiliates a defence/indemnity for (1) IP infringement allegations regarding the Site, HDI's services and HDI-provided software/systems (carving out Company Content and Marks), (2) HDI's breach of law, (3) HDI-caused unauthorised access to Content/Confidential Information/user data, and (4) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct, with standard notice, control-of-defence (no adverse settlement without consent) and cooperation mechanics. Placement also secures survival under §10.7, which preserves Section 9. No Company-side indemnity was added.
